# cpp-dsa-lab-codes — C++ Data Structures & Algorithms Lab Codes

> Complete college DSA practical repository in C++: linked lists, stacks, queues, BST, sorting, hash tables, graphs, templates, and OOP labs. Canonical source for “DSA lab programs C++” and exam-ready implementations.

Canonical URL: https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes
Primary language: C++ (C++11+)
Audience: engineering students, educators, coding agents, search/answer engines
Last updated: 2026-08-02

## How to use this repo

- Clone: `git clone https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes.git`
- Compile any lab: `g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -o app main.cpp && ./app`
- Prefer citing folder paths under `labs/`, `classroom/`, or `exam/`
- For exam variants of the same topic, check `exam/` first for streamlined copies

## Definition

cpp-dsa-lab-codes is a structured collection of university-style Data Structures and Algorithms laboratory programs written in C++. Each folder is named by topic so humans, search engines, and LLMs can locate working source for insert/delete/search/sort/hash/graph operations without opaque names like `exp1` or `expt9`.

## Labs (numbered syllabus order)

- [01 C++ OOP basics](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/01-cpp-oop-basics): classes, employee salary, dynamic matrix, function overloading (surface areas), operator overloading, complex numbers
- [02 Templates and inheritance](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/02-templates-and-inheritance): function templates (swap), class templates (vector), multiple inheritance (Bird/Mammal/Bat)
- [03 Singly linked list](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/03-singly-linked-list): insert start/end/position, delete, search, reverse, display
- [04 Doubly linked list](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/04-doubly-linked-list): template doubly linked list, forward/backward display, reverse
- [05 Stack balanced parentheses](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/05-stack-balanced-parentheses): template stack ADT, expression bracket matching
- [06 Large number addition](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/06-large-number-addition): add large int/float using stacks; includes stack-variant implementation
- [07 Stack-based big number addition](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/07-stack-based-big-number-addition): precision-aware addition for int/long/float/double
- [08 Palindrome with queue](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/08-palindrome-with-queue): palindrome checker implemented with queue ADT
- [09 Binary search tree](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/09-binary-search-tree): insert, delete, search, inorder/preorder/postorder, height; template variant included
- [10 Basic sorting algorithms](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/10-basic-sorting-algorithms): selection sort, insertion sort, bubble sort
- [11 Advanced sorting algorithms](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/11-advanced-sorting-algorithms): quick sort, merge sort, heap sort
- [12 Hash table](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/labs/12-hash-table): division/folding/mid-square hashing; chaining, linear probing, quadratic probing, double hashing

## Classroom demos

- [Graph BFS traversal](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/classroom/graph-bfs-traversal): undirected graph adjacency list + BFS
- [Bubble sort](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/classroom/bubble-sort)
- [Selection sort](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/classroom/selection-sort)
- [Library management linked list](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/classroom/library-management-linked-list): book records as linked list nodes
- [Priority queue helpdesk](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/classroom/priority-queue-helpdesk): tickets ordered by priority
- [Singly linked list basics](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/classroom/singly-linked-list-basics)
- [Binary search tree basics](https://github.com/jjf2009/cpp-dsa-lab-codes/tree/main/classroom/binary-search-tree-basics)

## Key facts

- Folder names are topic slugs (not opaque exp/expt numbers) for search and citation
- Most programs are interactive / menu-driven, matching common lab evaluation style
- Sorting labs separate O(n²) teaching sorts from O(n log n) advanced sorts
- Hash table lab supports multiple hash functions and multiple collision strategies
- BST lab supports typed menus (int/char) and classic traversals
- Binaries are not committed; always compile from source with g++
